verdict.rationale: Activepieces has a built-in MCP server that lets external MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc.) drive flows, tables, and automations, and this can even be embedded for end users to expose their own workflows as MCP tools with one click. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working in practice, and more detail on granularity of exposing individual app actions vs whole workflows as callable tools.
